title: Understanding Model Behavior in Monocular Polyp Sizing
authors: Xinqi (Ana) Xiong, Andrea Dunn Beltran, Jun Myeong Choi, Sarah K. McGill, Marc Niethammer, Roni Sengupta
summary: A diagnostic audit of monocular polyp size classification showing models lean on examination-behavior cues rather than true metric scale.

title: Stop Holding Your Breath: CT-Informed Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Bronchoscopy
authors: Andrea Dunn Beltran, Daniel Rho, Aarav Mehta, Xinqi (Ana) Xiong, Raúl San José Estépar, Ron Alterovitz, Marc Niethammer, Roni Sengupta
summary: We use paired inhale-exhale CTs to reduce respiratory motion to a single breathing phase, enabling deformation-aware bronchoscopic reconstruction without breath-holds.

title: Seeing Down the Line: Endoscopic Reconstruction with Centerline Constraints
authors: Andrea Dunn Beltran, Romain Hardy, Pranav Rajpurkar
summary: We add an online centerline and tubular coordinate system to Gaussian endoscopic reconstruction to regularize colon geometry and quantify inspected coverage.

title: Rendering with a Gut Feeling: Depth-Guided Triangle Splatting for Physically Consistent Colonoscopic Reconstruction
authors: Romain Hardy, Andrea Dunn Beltran, Todd A. Brenner, Tyler M. Berzin, Pranav Rajpurkar
summary: GutSee combines affine-invariant depth supervision with a coaxial spotlight illumination model for triangle-splatting colonoscopy reconstruction.

title: NFL-BA: Improving Endoscopic SLAM with Near-Field Light Bundle Adjustment
authors: Andrea Dunn Beltran*, Daniel Rho*, Marc Niethammer, Roni Sengupta
summary: We introduce a Bundle Adjustment loss using lighting cues to improve pose and map estimation in dense visual SLAM for endoscopy.

title: VIN-NBV: A View Introspection Network for Next-Best-View Selection for Resource-Efficient 3D Reconstruction
authors: Noah Frahm, Dongxu Zhao*, Andrea Dunn Beltran*, Ron Alterovitz, Jan-Michael Frahm, Junier Oliva, Roni Sengupta
summary: The VIN predicts reconstruction-quality gains for candidate views using 3D-aware features to improve 3D scene reconstruction.

title: PPS-Ctrl: Controllable Sim-to-Real Translation for Colonoscopy Depth Estimation
authors: Xinqi (Ana) Xiong, Andrea Dunn Beltran, Jun Myeong Choi, Marc Niethammer, Roni Sengupta
summary: PPS-Ctrl fuses Stable Diffusion and ControlNet, guided by physics-informed shading for structure-preserving endoscopy image translation.

title: Modulation of tau tubulin kinases (TTBK1 and TTBK2) impacts ciliogenesis
authors: Frances Bashore, Ariana Marquez, Apirat Chaikuad, Stefanie Howell, Andrea Dunn, Alvaro Beltran, Jeffery Smith, David Drewry, Adriana Beltran & Alison Axtman
summary: We designed a targeted library and identified chemical tools that engage TTBK1/2 and inhibit their downstream signaling.
